title: GET /books emits malformed JSON — isbn string unterminated in list path (FEEDBACK regression NOT fixed)
evidence: src/handler.cpp:228 `<< jsonEscape(book.isbn) << "}";` closes each list element with `}` instead of `\"}` — the isbn value opens with a quote (`\"isbn\": \"`) but never closes it, so every element is `..."isbn": "VALUE}` (invalid JSON). The single-book paths use the correct `\"}`: POST src/handler.cpp:210, PUT src/handler.cpp:258, GET-by-id src/handler.cpp:281. FEEDBACK.md:22 explicitly named this exact bug ('GET /books emits malformed JSON — isbn string is unterminated'); the repair did not fix the list path.
suggestion: Change line 228 to `<< jsonEscape(book.isbn) << "\"}";` to match the single-book serializers.

title: Validation errors return HTTP 200 instead of 400 — create without title/author not rejected with correct status
evidence: Validation runs and blocks persistence (src/handler.cpp:189-200: BookValidator::validate fails, returns `{"errors": [{"field":..,"message":..}]}` without calling db_.createBook). But the server's status inference success-branch matches any body containing `"message":` (src/server.cpp:182), and the error body contains `"message":` — so status_code is set to 200, never 400 (src/server.cpp:174-193). R9's how_to_verify requires 'rejected (400)'. Validation logic exists (src/model.cpp:4-30) but the HTTP status is wrong.
suggestion: In the default handler, detect the `{"errors":` shape (or have the handler signal a status) and map it to 400 BEFORE the generic `"message":`→200 check in src/server.cpp:178-193.

title: HTTP status codes are inferred by string-matching the response body, not set by the handler
evidence: src/server.cpp:174-193 guesses the status code from substrings ('healthy'/'id:'/'books:'/'message:' → 200, 'Not found' → 404, else 400). POST create returns 200 not 201 (src/handler.cpp:211 body has `"id":` → 200). Fragile and requirement-specific; correct codes are coincidental.
suggestion: Return an explicit (status, body) pair from the handler instead of string-sniffing the body in the server.

title: Validator requires isbn and year beyond the spec (spec: only title+author required)
evidence: src/model.cpp:18-27 rejects a create when isbn is empty or not 10/13 chars and when year is out of 0..2100. TASK.md/R9 require only title and author. POST /books with valid title+author but no isbn is rejected — stricter than spec.
suggestion: Make isbn/year validation non-blocking (or optional) so only title+author are mandatory.

title: Server test harness never fails — PASS/FAIL are only printed, runAllTests always returns 0
evidence: tests/test_server.cpp:252-272 runAllTests() prints 'PASS'/'FAIL' strings but never increments pass/fail counters and unconditionally `return 0;`. testListBooks (tests/test_server.cpp:111-120) only checks for the substring `"books":`, so it 'passes' even though the list JSON is malformed (see R8). These tests cannot catch the very regressions FEEDBACK flagged.
suggestion: Make each assertion set a non-zero exit code on FAIL so the build/test gate reflects real behavior.

title: GetBookById/Update/Delete tests self-skip when create returns no id
evidence: tests/test_server.cpp:151-153, 185-187, 219-221 print 'SKIP' and do nothing if the prior create response yielded no id — silently reducing effective coverage.
suggestion: Fail (not skip) when the create precondition doesn't hold.
